notes.note: Search: press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows) or the magnifying glass in the menu bar to find an app by name, or what's inside your apps. Use the arrow keys and Enter to open a result. My Account › Search sets which apps it looks in, and in what order.

Wall·E and the MixOS and MixOS Dark themes have new names that end in a short id, so they can't clash with someone else's extension. Wall·E keeps its place on your dashboard and the theme you picked stays applied; Wall·E's page is now /apps/wall-e-345e113c.

My MCP Connections has a tab each for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot: copy the URL, open the client in one click, or expand Manual instructions for the steps. Until a client is connected, that's all the page shows.

Release notes: the gift icon in the menu bar shows what changed in the last 14 days in MixOS and in the apps, connectors and theme you use, with a red dot on each one you haven't read. Release Notes in App Manager keeps them all.
